notes: The first visitor creates the workspace and its owner account on the setup page. Open the site and claim it immediately after install.

APP_URL is the site's HTTPS address; Docmost uses it for links, invitations and the real-time collaboration socket. APP_SECRET (32 characters, Docmost's documented minimum) signs sessions and tokens: keep it with your backups.

Docmost runs its database migrations itself at start-up. PostgreSQL 17.11 and Redis 8.8 have their own volumes and no published port; Redis runs with append-only persistence and the noeviction policy, as in the official compose file.
Attachments and images live in the storage volume (/app/data/storage, local storage driver). Telemetry is turned off.
Inviting members by email needs SMTP (MAIL_DRIVER/SMTP_* settings); invitation links can also be copied and shared from the members page.
The healthcheck probes /api/health/live on 127.0.0.1 with curl, which the image ships.
The 1g floor covers the Node server and its collaboration engine; the database and Redis use the panel database-memory default.
